en: I pay homage to Mañjuśrī, the Great Hero, the Lord of Speech of the Dharmadhātu-maṇḍala, the destroyer of all Māras,
the Lord of all accomplishments, the Protector, the Sovereign of Speech. (1)
I pay homage to Mañjughoṣa, the great hero, the destroyer of all Māras, the bestower of all forms, the Dharmadhātu. (2)
I bow to Mahoṣṇīṣa, to the white parasol, to the mass of splendor arisen from victory,
to him who has emerged from the rays, and to the one of great and fierce majesty.
I bow to Akṣobhya and Mahābodhi, and to Vajrasattva;
I bow to Vajrarāja, Vajrarāga, and Vajrasādhu. (4)
I bow to the Lord Śrī Ratnasambhava, the Vajra-jewel;
I always pay homage to Vajrasūrya, Vajraketu, and Vajrahāsa. (5)
I bow to the Great King Amitābha, to Vajradharma;
I bow, I bow to Vajratīkṣṇa, the Great Banner, and Vajrabhāṣa. 6.
I bow to Amoghasiddhi, the Lord of Accomplishments, Vajrakarma;
I always pay homage to Vajrarakṣa, Vajrayakṣa, and Vajrasandhi. (7)
I bow to the Great Goddess named Locanā, and I bow to her named Pāṇḍarā; I bow again and again to that Goddess Māmakī and to Goddess Tārā.
I bow, I bow to the great hero Vajrāṅkuśa, to the immensely radiant Vajrapāśa, to the great lord Vajrasphoṭa, and to Vajrāveśa. 9.
I bow to the stage of Adhimukti-īśvarī, the Joyous (Pramuditā);
I bow again and again to the great stage named Vimalā and to Prabhākarī. 10.
I bow to Arciṣmatī and Sudurjayā; I pay homage to Abhimukhī. I revere Dūraṅgamā, the one called Acalā, and the sovereign Sādhumatī.
I bow to the Dharmameghā, the great cloud, the radiance known as Samatā;
I bow to the goddess Ratnapāramitā, the perfection of generosity. 12.
I bow to the goddess Śīlapāramitā and to Kṣāntipāramitā;
I take refuge in the goddess Vīryapāramitā and Dhyānapāramitā. 13.
I constantly pay homage to the goddess Prajñāpāramitā, who is known as Upāya, as well as to the power of aspiration and the Jñānapāramitā. 14.
I likewise perpetually bow to the goddess Karmapāramitā;
I bow to Longevity, Mental Requisites, and Rebirth through Karma. 15.
I bow to the goddess named Ṛddhi, to Adhimukti, and to Praṇidhāna;
I pay homage to the goddess named Jñāna-vaśitā and to Dharma-vaśitā. 16.
I bow to Tathatā, the Great Goddess, and to the awakening of the Buddhas;
I bow again and again to Vasumatī, Mahālakṣmī, and Ratnajvālā. 17.
I pay homage to the goddess Uṣṇīṣavijayā, Mārīcī, Parṇaśābarī, Jāṅgulī, the Dhāraṇī, and the Anantamukhadhāraṇī. 18.
I pay homage to Cundā, to Prajñā, and to Padmā, the purifier of all obscurations; to the inexhaustible casket of wisdom, who possesses the Dharmakāya. (19)
The god who has penetrated the Dharma, the analytical knowledge of meaning, the analytical knowledge of language, and the analytical knowledge known as eloquence; || 20 ||
I always bow to Vajralāsyā, Vajramālā, and Vajragītā;
with constant joy, I pay homage to the great goddess Vajranṛtyā. (21)
I bow to Samantabhadra, the Lord of Enlightenment and the inexhaustible intellect;
I pay homage to the Bodhisattvas Kṣitigarbha and Khagarbha. 22.
I bow, I bow to Gaṇanātheśa and Ratnapāṇi;
I pay homage to Sāgaramati, Bodhīśa, and Vajragarbha. || 23 ||
I bow to the Great Being Lokeśvara, who has attained his station;
I pay homage to Candraprabha of great splendor and to Jālinīprabha. (24)
I bow to Amitaprabhabodheśa, the Lord of Śrī, who is the peak of the sun, and who dispels the obstruction of all grief and darkness. (25)
I bow, I bow to Yamāntaka, the great hero; I bow to Prajñāntaka.
I pay homage to Padmāntaka, the great hero; I bow to Vighnāntaka. (26)
I bow to the hero Trailokyavijaya, to Vajrajvālā;
I bow to Heruka, the Lord of Vajra Heroes, the Supreme Lord. || 27 ||
I bow to the sovereign Cakravartin; I pay homage to Sumbharāja.
I pay homage to the goddess Puṣpā, Dhūpā, Mahādīpā, and Gandhā. || 28 ||
I bow to her whose form is vajra, whose sound is vajra, and who is the vajra of taste;
I always revere the Great Goddess, the vajra of touch, who possesses every color. (29)
I bow to Indra, Yama, Varuṇa, Kubera, and Īśvara;
I also pay homage to Agni, the lord of the Nairṛtya direction, and Vāyu, the king of the wind.
I bow to Brahmā, the god Viṣṇu, Maheśvara, and Kumāraka; and to the great goddess Brahmāṇī, Rudrāṇī, and Vaiṣṇavī.
I bow to Kaumārī of red complexion and to Mahendrāṇī;
to Vārāhī, Kālikā, Caṇḍī, Bhṛṅgin, and Gaṇanāyaka.
I bow to Mahākāla, the most terrifying Nandikeśa, and Ravi;
I praise Candra, Bhauma, Budha, Guru, Śukra, and Śanaiścara.
I always bow to Rāhu, Ketu, Balabhadra, and Jayakara; I bow to Madhukara, Vasanta, Ananta, and Vāsuki.
I bow to Takṣaka, Karkoṭaka, Padma, and Mahāpadma; I pay homage to Śaṅkhapāla, Kulika, Vemacitra, and Bali.
I always bow to the great Daitya Prahlāda and Vairocana;
I pay homage to the lord of Garuḍas, Sumbharāja, and Pañcaśikha.
I bow to Sarvārthasiddhi, Vighneśa, and Pūrṇabhadra;
to Maṇibhadra, the great Yakṣa, and to Dhanada, the Great Lord.
I bow to Vaiśravaṇa, the great hero, and to Civikuṇḍalin;
I bow to Keli, Mālin, Sukhendra, and Calendra. || 38 ||
I bow to the goddess Hāratī, the Yakṣiṇī who possesses many sons;
likewise to Aśvinī, Bharaṇī, Tārā, Kṛttikā, and Rohiṇī.
I likewise bow to Mṛgaśīrṣā, Ārdrā, and Punarvasu;
to Puṣya, the stars of Āśleṣā, Maghā, and Pūrvāphālgunī.
I bow to Uttaraphalgunī, Hasta, Citrā, Svātī, Viśākhā, as well as Anurādhā, Jyeṣṭhā, and the Mūla constellation. || 41 ||
I bow to Pūrvāṣāḍhā, Uttarāṣāḍhā, and Śravaṇā;
to Dhaniṣṭhā, Śatabhiṣā, and Pūrvā- and Uttarā-Bhādrapadā. || 42 ||
I bow to Revatī and Mahātārā, and I bow to Abhijit;
I bow to the great hero Vajrāṅkuśa and to Vajrapāśa. || 43 ||
I bow, I bow indeed to Vajrasphoṭa, the most terrifying, to Vajrāṃśa, to Vāgīśvara, the Great Awakening, the destroyer of all obstacles. 44.
I bow to the Omniscient One, the bestower of knowledge, the Dharmadhātu;
I bow to Mañjuśrī of great wisdom, the sovereign lord of all sciences, who possesses the nature of all forms, the King of Speakers. (45)
The Praise to the Maṇḍala of the Glorious Dharmadhātuvāgīśvara is complete.
